tiana_sales: FYI BlackOak asked for a 3-week POC to validate our agent on support tickets. They gave rough numbers: 1.5k DAU, ~2k sessions/day, avg 120 tokens/response, burst factor 5 during an 2-3 hour window. Success criteria: p95 latency <200ms, accuracy >=90% on their labeled set, and total spend <= $3.5k for the POC.

dan_se: Quick clarifying q's: is 2k sessions/day counting retries? streaming required? any multi-turn context preserved across sessions?

tiana_sales: 2k is successful sessions (retries small). Streaming preferred but not mandatory. Sessions may include a short 2-message context.

olga_sre: Capacity quick calc: baseline RPS = 2000 / 86400 = 0.023. If 70% of traffic is in a 3h peak: peak RPS ~= (2000 * 0.7) / (3*3600) = ~0.13 rps. With burst factor 5 -> ~0.65 rps. For 120 tokens avg response, token generation rate at peak ~78 tokens/s.

simon_ml: Model/infra notes: for POC we can use an optimized 4-bit quantized variant. Measured single-stream throughput numbers: T4-like cards ~200-400 tok/s, A10/A100 ~800-1600 tok/s depending on model and seq len. Even with conservative 200 tok/s, one GPU is plenty for the traffic and should meet p95 if we keep batching small and enable streaming.

dan_se: Ops suggestion: host on Hosted with a Dedicated-equivalent single-GPU reservation + burst policy (auto-add second GPU if cpu/RPS spike >0.5 rps). Set request timeout 4s, keep small max batch size (1-2) to hit latency SLO.

leah_ps: Pricing check: using example token rate $0.00025/token -> daily tokens = 2000 * 120 = 240k -> 30d = 7.2M tokens -> ~$1,800. Add eval traffic: they plan an eval run of 5k prompts in week 1 -> +600k tokens -> +$150. Ops/infra uplift + margin -> estimate total ~$2.5k. Well under their $3.5k cap, gives headroom for extra debugging traffic.

tiana_sales: They also asked: can we provide audit logs, data deletion at end of trial, and a short SOC2 artifacts pack within 30 days? Procurement flagged those as blockers.

leah_ps: NDA yes. Data deletion: we can run purges and confirm; we have an endpoint for one-off dataset deletion. Audit logs: we can increase Console retention for the POC to 90 days and provide export. SOC2: we can supply existing SOC2 report and supporting artifacts but we cannot produce a new attestation in 30 days. Offer: provide artifacts + enhanced logging for the POC.

olga_sre: Operational items to include in SOW/runbook: enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts, add a model-variant fallback to a smaller model if gen time >2s, instrument eval webhook to publish copies to BlackOak's eval pipeline, and set circuit-breaker to reject new requests if queue depth > 10.

simon_ml: Also recommend throttling for long-context requests: if context tokens >800, route to constrained model or return a truncation warning. Include that in runbook.

deploy_bot: ticket#4839 created: "BlackOak POC - sizing, billing estimate, logs & SOC2 artifacts". Assigned: olga_sre, simon_ml, leah_ps.

dan_se: Next steps: (1) I'll draft a 1-page SOW with traffic assumptions + two pricing options (hosted token-billing cap OR dedicated 1 GPU with weekly flat fee), (2) ops sync 30m to confirm autoscale params, (3) PS to prepare data deletion + log export playbook.

tiana_sales: Thanks. ETA for SOW draft: tomorrow EOD. I'll add BlackOak contact and procurement cc once SOW ready. :raised_hands:

leah_ps: I'll prepare the artifact list for SOC2 and confirm log retention cost by EOD.

olga_sre: I'll post sample autoscale config and a short runbook snippet in the ops sync.

tiana_sales: Great — closing the loop here. Will update once BlackOak gives real DAU/session numbers. :thumbsup:
